mapper.insert: insert into `submission`(contest_id, problem_id, student_id, language, code, status, score, time_used, memory_used, result_msg, detail, submit_time, judge_time) values (#{contestId}, #{problemId}, #{studentId}, #{language}, #{code}, #{status}, #{score}, #{timeUsed}, #{memoryUsed}, #{resultMsg}, #{detail}, #{submitTime}, #{judgeTime})
mapper.update: update `submission` set contest_id = #{contestId}, problem_id = #{problemId}, student_id = #{studentId}, language = #{language}, code = #{code}, status = #{status}, score = #{score}, time_used = #{timeUsed}, memory_used = #{memoryUsed}, result_msg = #{resultMsg}, detail = #{detail}, submit_time = #{submitTime}, judge_time = #{judgeTime} where id = #{id}
